inlines.v: INCON'TINENT, adjective [Latin incontinens.] Not restraining the passions or appetites, particularly the sexual appetite; indulging lust without restraint or in violation of law; unchaste; lewd. 1. Unable to restrain discharges. In the sense of immediate or immediately, obs. INCON'TINENT, noun One who is unchaste.
